import pandas as pd,numpy as np,sys
w=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1]);c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.year.describe()); print(w.work_id.duplicated().sum())
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']); w=w[w.n_passages>0]
w['late']=w.year>=1876; w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
w['prod']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
for col in ['genre','origin','date_confidence']:
    print(pd.crosstab(w[col],w.late))
print(w.groupby('late')[['n_editions','prod','n_passages']].mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
    return (g[True]-g[False]).dropna().mean(), g
def boot(d,B=2000):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0);out=[]
    gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby('genre')]
    for _ in range(B):
        out.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs]))[0])
    return np.nanpercentile(out,[2.5,97.5])
e,g=est(w);print(g);print('all',e,boot(w))
for dc in w.date_confidence.unique():
    s=w[w.date_confidence==dc];print(dc,len(s),est(s)[0])
for o in w.origin.unique():
    s=w[w.origin==o];print(o,len(s),est(s)[0])
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
m=smf.wls('r~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log1p(n_editions)+np.log(prod)',w,weights=w.n_passages).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kws={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes})
print(m.params['late[T.True]'],m.conf_int().loc['late[T.True]'])
p
